items.title: Inkling 2 Mini

extra.evidence: Inkling 2 Mini is an open-weights model small enough to run on your laptop. It loops its middle layers to reason more per token and reach answers in fewer tokens. Today we are releasing Inkling 2 Mini, a fast, powerful model that’s small enough to run on your laptop. Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. Inkling 2 Mini leads every open-weights model with less than 100B total parameters on benchmarks such as DeepSWE v1.1 (48.2%) and Vals Index v2.2 (46.5%). It runs faster than similarly performing models as well. Inkling 2 Mini is a Mixture-of-Experts mod…

items.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
items.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: huggingface/transformers v5.24.0

extra.evidence: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images…

items.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
items.summary: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
items.summary_zh: 现有双系统智能体依赖特定工作流钩子，AnyS1将人类编写的程序技能转化为共享的通用决策点。通过离线挖掘和训练，AnyS1在保持任务可靠性的同时，将成本和模型调用时间分别降低了75-91%和63-92%。

items.title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
items.summary: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.
items.title_zh: NarrowSpec：草案隐藏宽度不必匹配目标
items.summary_zh: 草案模型通常继承目标模型的隐藏宽度，NarrowSpec表明草案的残差流可以以一半或四分之一宽度运行，同时保持较高的接受率。在B200和DGX Spark上，将草案宽度减半或减至四分之一可分别实现1.06-1.12倍和1.13-1.44倍的速度提升。

items.title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
items.summary: Whether a stored memory helps answer a user's question often depends on world knowledge rather than surface similarity. Jetriever replaces similarity search with full-pool utility scoring: given a query, it uses Jev, an LLM-derived System One decision model, to score every stored memory for the probability that it is useful to the answer, ranking the memory pool directly by those probabilities. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, Jetriever places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases (versus 1.6% for BM25 and 0.0% for MiniLM with user-turn indexing) and reaches 76.0% end-to-end Application, compared with at most 16.0% across published retrieval and memory systems. A controlled 20-question comparison disentangles recognizing implicit evidence from ranking it properly: Jev and Qwen3.5-9B both recover 90% of gold exchanges within the top 50 (versus 30% for the BERT-based decision model Laya), yet at rank 1 Jev reaches 85% while Qwen3.5-9B drops to 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever raises the four-dimension average from 44.3% (ReFind) to 55.4%, at a mean retrieval cost of USD 0.00834 per InMind query and USD 0.03103 per MAB query. Together, these results show that effective utility retrieval hinges on combining broad world knowledge, calibrated ranking probabilities, and affordable full-pool evaluation.
items.summary_zh: Jetriever用效用评分替代相似性搜索，利用LLM决策模型对存储的记忆进行有用性评分。在InMind的125个间接查询任务中，Jetriever在84.8%的情况下将正确答案排在第一位，端到端应用准确率达到76.0%。

items.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
items.summary: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is $5.85\times$ on Ouro-2.6B and $5.13\times$ on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.
items.title_zh: LoopFill：循环Transformer的流水线多令牌草案解码
items.summary_zh: LoopFill是一种无训练的草案解码算法，结合多令牌后缀草案和浅层循环预测。在七个基准测试中，LoopFill在Ouro-2.6B和Huginn-3.5B上的平均加速比分别为5.85倍和5.13倍，超过最强基线LoopAhead。

items.title: Latency, Speech Recognition and Turn-Taking in Voice Agents for Spanish Phone Negotiation: An Externally Measured Comparison of Pipecat, LiveKit and GPT-Live
items.summary: A voice agent that negotiates by phone must answer quickly, understand spoken amounts and cope with a caller who talks over it. We compared three architectures for such an agent, negotiating freight rates in Spanish: two cascades (speech recognition, language model and speech synthesis) orchestrated by Pipecat and by LiveKit Agents, and GPT-Live, an OpenAI speech model that listens and speaks without separate stages. A program played the carrier with the same 47 recordings of one speaker for all agents, without the telephone network, in 77 calls per architecture over five negotiation scenarios, and measured latency on the listener's side with a validated instrument. Median latency to the content response was 2,616.0 ms (Pipecat), 3,090.0 ms (LiveKit) and 2,444.8 ms (GPT-Live); the confidence interval of GPT-Live's 171.2 ms advantage over Pipecat includes zero. According to its own timestamps, GPT-Live began to answer 800 ms after the end of the line, close to the 0.8 s published by OpenAI; most of the remaining wait, about 1,367 ms and nearly constant, is the audio's round trip through OpenAI's service. A tool call added 0.9-1.1 s in every architecture, more than any difference between them, and the frameworks' self-reported latency fell short of the listener's wait by 9% (Pipecat) and 22% (LiveKit). Word error rates were low (6.03, 4.93 and 1.47%), but the error on amounts was 13.01% and 12.61% in the cascades, against 2.86% in GPT-Live. With default settings, Pipecat and L…

2e19ab523196.body: Apple发布Depth Pro 2，通过单一可扩展网络在全分辨率下预测深度图，克服了时间一致性和边界清晰度的权衡。

816af3ca0938.headline: Nvidia研究员讨论上下文窗口
816af3ca0938.body: Nvidia研究员提出替代方案，通过周期性摘要和关键词搜索匹配全上下文结果，并建议使用短上下文模型。

a4f31a72ec57.headline: Hugging Face欢迎Inkling 2 Mini
a4f31a72ec57.body: Hugging Face博客欢迎Thinking Machines Lab推出的Inkling 2 Mini，称其为支持1M token上下文和图像输入的循环Transformer模型。

f6df913aa0ba.headline: opensre：CI/CD可靠性智能体
f6df913aa0ba.body: Tracer-Cloud开源opensre，这是一个用于CI/CD可靠性的智能体工具。

36da3aef8edf.headline: LangChain发布知识工厂
36da3aef8edf.body: LangChain发布知识工厂，智能体标记缺失内容，策展智能体在后台修复，保持公司知识更新。

271b21f5036d.headline: Inkling-2-Mini：图文理解模型
271b21f5036d.body: thinkingmachines发布Inkling-2-Mini图文理解模型，许可证为apache-2.0。

d96d67a4929c.headline: OpenVINO：AI推理优化工具包
d96d67a4929c.body: openvinotoolkit开源OpenVINO，这是一个用于优化和部署AI推理的工具包。

151f8398c0a5.headline: OpenSpec：AI编码助手规范驱动开发
151f8398c0a5.body: Fission-AI开源OpenSpec，为AI编码助手提供规范驱动的开发方式。

76c545905db1.headline: transformers发布5.24.0版本
76c545905db1.body: huggingface/transformers发布5.24.0版本，新增Inkling 2 Mini模型，支持文本和图像输入，具有循环机制和128个专家。

a2e5e20500d6.headline: sprite-stacking：Agent技能工具
a2e5e20500d6.body: danielwh2开源sprite-stacking，可将四个像素艺术视图转换为可旋转的假3D精灵。

ef783a273674.headline: phonebox：旧安卓手机桌面控制面板
ef783a273674.body: ersinkoc开源phonebox，可将旧安卓手机改装为Windows、Linux和macOS的桌面控制面板。

5338508548af.headline: AnyS1：通用决策点框架
5338508548af.body: AnyS1将人类编写的程序技能转化为共享的通用决策点，降低成本和模型调用时间。

a989c418dc1c.headline: NarrowSpec：草案隐藏宽度优化
a989c418dc1c.body: NarrowSpec表明草案模型的残差流可以以一半或四分之一宽度运行，同时保持较高的接受率。

4e39ba9df723.headline: Jetriever：从相似性到效用
4e39ba9df723.body: Jetriever用效用评分替代相似性搜索，利用LLM决策模型对存储的记忆进行有用性评分。

c40d66ad7ebe.headline: LoopFill：循环Transformer的流水线多令牌草案解码
c40d66ad7ebe.body: LoopFill是一种无训练的草案解码算法，结合多令牌后缀草案和浅层循环预测。

fb919c81601e.headline: 语音代理延迟与识别对比
fb919c81601e.body: 研究比较了Pipecat、LiveKit和GPT-Live在西班牙语电话谈判中的延迟和语音识别表现。
